title: German Keto Butter Wrap
description: A keto-friendly take on the classic German butter wrap, using a low-carb wrap and topped with a variety of keto-approved ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Butter the low-carb wrap on both sides.
Place the wrap in the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cream cheese, diced onion, and chopped fresh dill.
Spread the cream cheese mixture onto one half of the wrap.
Top the cream cheese mixture with smoked salmon slices.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the filling is heated through.
